entries.name: Shecan
entries.notes: Free tier (documented support for Google AI/Gemini, Steam, Apple, Docker). Official notice: the free tier is currently restricted and only usable with international access; the paid 'Shecan Pro' addresses are listed separately.

entries.name: 403.online
entries.notes: Private-range addresses: works only on Iranian ISP connections. DoH/DoT supported.

entries.name: Radar Game
entries.notes: Gaming-focused (National Computer Games Foundation). Private-range: Iranian ISPs only.

entries.name: Electro
entries.notes: Top pick for PSN/Xbox/launchers per community tests.

entries.name: Electro (new)
entries.notes: Newer published address set for Electro (stable ping for EA/FC 26).

entries.name: Begzar
entries.notes: General anti-sanction DNS, good complement for launchers.

entries.name: Pishgaman
entries.notes: Console/community favorite. Only reachable from within Iranian networks.

entries.name: Shatel
entries.notes: Only recommended for Shatel ISP subscribers.

entries.name: Zeus
entries.notes: Popular Iranian gaming/anti-sanction DNS; also advertised for Spotify, YouTube and OpenAI. Free.

entries.name: Shelter
entries.notes: Gaming anti-sanction DNS. Paid per-IP VIP plans; the shared public pair rotates, so treat these as best-effort.

entries.name: Hostiran
entries.notes: Private-range addresses (172.16/12): reachable only from Iranian ISP connections. Vendor anti-sanction service.

entries.name: Server.ir
entries.notes: Free anti-sanction DNS (Apple, GitHub, PSN and more). The official site issues addresses by signup; these are the widely published pair.

entries.name: Shecan Pro
entries.notes: Paid Shecan tier (activated for your registered IP). The free tier is 178.22.122.100 / 185.51.200.2.

entries.name: Vanilla
entries.notes: Gaming DNS. Private-range: Iranian ISPs only.

entries.name: Google Public DNS
entries.notes: Baseline for stability and downloads; does NOT bypass sanctions.

entries.name: Cloudflare
entries.notes: Fastest anycast resolver; does NOT bypass sanctions.

entries.name: Cloudflare Families (malware)
entries.notes: Blocks malware domains only; adult content stays reachable (verified).

entries.name: Cloudflare Families (adult)
entries.notes: Blocks malware AND adult content (verified: adult domains resolve to 0.0.0.0).

entries.name: Quad9
entries.notes: Swiss no-log policy, blocks malicious domains.

entries.name: OpenDNS (Cisco)
entries.notes: Long-standing stable resolver.

entries.name: Verisign
entries.notes: Operates .com/.net root infrastructure.

entries.name: AdGuard DNS
entries.notes: Blocks ads and trackers at DNS level.

entries.name: Control D
entries.notes: Unfiltered 'p0' anycast endpoints.

entries.name: Comodo Secure
entries.notes: Security-filtered SECURE DNS by Comodo.

entries.name: Neustar UltraDNS
entries.notes: Sometimes recommended for lower packet loss.

entries.name: Hurricane Electric
entries.notes: Single anycast IP from HE in Houston.

entries.name: Yandex
entries.notes: Geo-close alternative for some Iranian routes. Unfiltered (Basic) profile.

entries.name: Yandex Family
entries.notes: Yandex family profile: blocks adult content (verified: adult domains are redirected to safe2.yandex.ru).

entries.name: NTT
entries.notes: Suggested in Iranian gaming guides as a download/latency alternative.

entries.name: DNS.SB
entries.notes: No-log resolver, DNSSEC enabled. DoT: dot.sb.

entries.name: DNS.WATCH
entries.notes: Uncensored no-log resolver, online since 2014, DNSSEC enabled.

entries.name: UncensoredDNS
entries.notes: Danish no-log, uncensored resolver (anycast 91.239.100.100 + unicast 89.233.43.71). Best-effort: on some networks TCP:53 connects but queries get no reply (network-level interception), so it can time out here while working on other ISPs.

entries.name: DNS4EU (unfiltered)
entries.notes: EU-run public resolver (Whalebone) with no content filtering, under EU/GDPR rules.

entries.name: NextDNS
entries.notes: Anycast resolver: applies your NextDNS profile when configured, otherwise plain unfiltered resolution.

entries.name: SafeDNS
entries.notes: Long-running public resolver with optional content filtering.

entries.name: CZ.NIC ODVR
entries.notes: Run by CZ.NIC (the .cz registry): no logging, DNSSEC validation, Prague.

entries.name: AdGuard Family
entries.notes: AdGuard family-protection profile: ads, trackers and adult content.

entries.name: CleanBrowsing (family)
entries.notes: CleanBrowsing family filter (blocks adult content).

entries.name: CleanBrowsing (adult)
entries.notes: Adult-content filter only (verified: adult domains return NXDOMAIN); also forces safe search.

entries.name: OpenDNS FamilyShield
entries.notes: OpenDNS profile that blocks adult content out of the box.

entries.name: CleanBrowsing (security)
entries.notes: Malware/phishing blocking only — adult content stays reachable (verified).
